title: Slot Glow
description: A lightweight client-side mod that replaces the vanilla slot highlight with a customizable one.
body:
SlotGlow is a lightweight client mod that replaces the standard inventory slot lighting with a **your** custom color. It supports several lighting modes: a plain vanilla look, a fully custom a vanilla lighting without dimming over items.

![Highlighting Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b460a5ba92793ebfe64c395758d1b9955d24b49.png)

Works with all inventory GUIs: player, furnace, workbench, enchanting table etc. Settings are available through the standard mod configuration menu or the /slotglow command, where you can choose the lighting color using the built-in color picker.


![Highlighting Example in Stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66bd5c9374fb13444f277cdf89129a51a3f9980b.png)
